note: base_sha is set by `PYTHONPATH=orchestrator python3 -m monitoring.benchmark freeze` after the bench app is staged and seeded (see docs/benchmark-protocol.md). {pass} in a request is replaced by a short id of the pass, so each pass uses flag names no earlier pass created (GrowthBook cannot delete a feature, and an existing flag is never re-released).

tasks.request: Add GET /api/version that answers 200 with the JSON {"version": "1"}. It is a user-visible change, so ship it behind a feature flag named `version-{pass}`: with the flag off the route answers 404 like any unknown route. Keep all other behaviour unchanged.

Add PUT /api/todos/:id/text that renames a todo. Behind a feature flag named `rename-{pass}`. The body is {"text": string}. Answer 200 with the updated todo. The text is trimmed; blank or whitespace-only text answers 400 {"error": "text is required"}; text over 200 characters answers 400 {"error": "text too long"}; an id that is not a positive integer (0, -1, 1abc) answers 400 {"error": "invalid id"}; an unknown id answers 404 {"error": "not found"}.

Refactor only: move the todo text trimming that POST /api/todos does into one small helper function used by both POST /api/todos and any other route that trims todo text, with no change to behaviour. It is an internal change that users cannot see, so it needs no feature flag. All existing tests must still pass.
